name: How long does a typical septic tank replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical septic tank replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a septic tank replacement project can vary significantly based on factors like the size of the new tank, site accessibility, soil conditions, and the need for new drain field installation. Generally, a replacement project can take anywhere from a few days to over a week once excavation begins. Weather conditions in areas like Las Vegas can also influence the timeline, as heavy rain, though rare, can delay excavation and installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Septic tank replacement typically takes a few days to over a week, depending on tank size, site conditions, and drain field requirements.
